summary: Calvi Sainte Catherine Airport serves the resort town of Calvi on the northwestern coast of Corsica, offering travelers gateway access to one of the Mediterranean's most picturesque coastal destinations. The airport operates alongside a French Navy airbase, sharing a single runway with military traffic. It is a seasonal gateway popular with summer visitors heading to the historic Citadel of Calvi and the surrounding Balagne region.
faqs:
Q: How far is Calvi Airport from the town center?
A: The airport is approximately 7 km southeast of Calvi's town center and historic Citadel, a drive of around 15 minutes.

Q: Which airlines operate at Calvi Sainte Catherine Airport?
A: Primarily Air France, Air Corsica, and several seasonal charter carriers serve the airport with routes mainly to Paris, Nice, and other French cities.

Q: Does the airport handle international flights?
A: International flights are limited and mostly seasonal, connecting to a handful of European cities during the summer tourist season.

Q: Is Calvi Airport open year-round?
A: The airport operates year-round but sees significantly reduced schedules outside the busy summer months from May to September.
transport_tips: Taxis and shuttle buses are available outside the terminal for the short transfer into Calvi town. Pre-booking a rental car is advisable during peak summer months, as local roads to the Balagne villages and beaches fill up quickly.
local_tip: The airport shares its runway with a French Navy base, so expect occasional military helicopter activity—sit on the right side of the plane for classic views of the snow-dusted mountains meeting the turquoise sea on final approach.
